    Publications

    Publications & Presentations

    Journal Articles

    Modeling the Conversion Process of Syngas to Methanol Production

    Begench Charyyevich Garahanov

    Proceedings of International Scientific-Practical Conference «Sustainable Development Goals: Youth Policy and Innovative Technologies», February 15–16, 2023, Oguz Han Engineering and Technology University of Turkmenistan, Ashgabat

    Developed a digital twin of a chemical methanol production process using Honeywell's UniSim® Design Suite. Created static and dynamic models of synthesis gas production processes, designed an automated control system, and built a unified technological line in virtual space. The virtual simulator enables personnel to master production processes without risk to equipment or safety.

    DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.7776863

    Conference Presentations

    Best Presentation Award — International Scientific-Practical Conference

    Sustainable Development Goals: Youth Policy and Innovative Technologies, February 2023, Oguz Han Engineering and Technology University of Turkmenistan

    Awarded the Best Presentation Prize for outstanding research presentation on digital twin modeling of syngas-to-methanol conversion processes.

    Research Interests

    My research focuses on the intersection of engineering, econometrics, and policy science. Key areas include:

    • Mathematical Modeling for Policy Prediction — Using large-scale data with Python and Stata to model and forecast policy outcomes
    • Digital Twins & Process Simulation — Creating virtual models of industrial chemical processes for training and optimization
    • Energy Systems Analysis — Building on an Applied Chemistry foundation to analyze energy policy and sustainability
    • Quantitative Methods in Social Science — Applying econometric techniques to social and economic policy questions
